name: Vase with Three Rams' Heads
dimensions: Diameter: 9.4 cm (3 11/16 in.); Overall: 14 cm (5 1/2 in.)
summary: In cloisonné enameling, the decorative patterns are outlined by soldering metal wires (usually copper) to a metal base, creating a network of cells, or cloisons, to be filled with powdered enamels.
